paragraphs.text: Full-stack engineer with 6+ years of experience across freelance work, contract SaaS, and founding my own.
I ship Next.js products end to end, from the first sketch to the thing running in production: UI, APIs, AI integrations, and the systems underneath them.
On the side I build small tools for the parts of my own workflow that annoy me. Those live on the
Based in Hyderabad, India, working remote with teams across time zones. When I'm not shipping, I'm usually writing about what broke and what I'd do differently.
